title: Short headless session for Brett.
asked: Short headless session for Brett. Opus. Read /opt/axf/CLAUDE.md + _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md first. Two finished, tested branches in MossesX/AmberX-AXF clash with main. Resolve and land them, IN THIS ORDER: 1. claude/shots-tab (UI Review Screenshots tab). Clash: apps/console-web/plugins/output-recorder/web/core.ts (main got the recorder-control change e46b8079 / axHub decision #108). 2. claude/watch-live (Watch live hot render). Clash: .gitignore (keep both sides' lines). For each: git clone or worktree from /opt/axf (git -c safe.directory='*'), checkout the branch from origin, git merge origin/main. Notes/bookkeeping files (THREADS.md, STATUS.md, decisions.md, orchestrator/pending JSON): keep both sides (union / 3-way JSON). Code: keep BOTH intents, never drop main's recorder-control changes or the branch's feature. Validate every changed JSON parses. Run the affected tests: output-recorder self-test + plugin test.py, ui-review tests, watch-live checks, console typecheck + build, theme/controls/lifecycle checks. Machine-setup failures that also fail on clean main are fine (Node 20, sync-held files) - say so. Push: git push origin HEAD:main (the server's git login was just fixed to the working token; if push still gets 401, fall back to: T=$(grep -m1 '^GITHUB_TOKEN=' /opt/axf/.axf-console/secrets.env | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"\r '); git -c http.extraheader="AUTHORIZATION: basic $(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$T" | base64 -w0)" push origin HEAD:main ; never print the token). If main moved, fetch+merge+retest+push again. End with a 5-line plain-English summary: what clashed, how you resolved it, tests, commits on main.

result.summary: Landed claude/shots-tab (c777b8ee) and claude/watch-live (60752f86) on main; clashes resolved keeping both sides; all affected tests pass
